brand_identity.name: ADELFOS MARKETING
brand_identity.positioning: WE BUILD DIGITAL EMPIRES FOR LOCAL BUSINESS.
brand_identity.vibe: High-gravity editorial, Awwwards-level Framer agency, stark monochrome with electric red impact, asymmetric Swiss grid, heavy typographic authority, brutal precision.

rules.tinted_grey: Use #0A0A0A and #121212 rather than pure grey for surfaces.
rules.red_usage: Accent #FF3131 used sparingly (< 5% screen area) for hover highlights, active tab indicators, kinetic cursors, and key metrics.

typography.pairing_strategy: Editorial Future (High Contrast Display + Sterile Precision Sans & Accent Serif)

editorial_accent.usage: Used for emphatic inline story words in hero & section statements

mono.usage: Used for step counters (01, 02), timestamps, tags, and stats labels

scale.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold uppercase leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter
scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold uppercase leading-[0.95] tracking-tighter
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold uppercase leading-[1.0] tracking-tight
scale.subtitle: text-base sm:text-xl text-neutral-400 font-normal leading-relaxed max-w-2xl
scale.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-neutral-400

cursor.behavior: Follows mouse position with smooth spring physics on desktop viewports. Morphs into a red square or 'VIEW' pill when hovering case study cards, expandable video frames, and CTAs.
cursor.implementation: Framer Motion pointer events container with pointer-events-none z-50 fixed.

page_transitions.motif: 4-triangle geometric logo animation overlay that sweeps in on route changes with high contrast black/red background fill.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: 12-column sharp asymmetric grid with crisp subtle 1px borders (#1F1F1F) and deep dark canvas

buttons_and_interactions.primary_button: bg-white text-black font-semibold uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#FF3131] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border border-white group
buttons_and_interactions.secondary_button: bg-transparent text-white font-medium uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-widest px-8 py-4 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-white transition-all duration-300 group
buttons_and_interactions.accent_button: bg-[#FF3131] text-white font-semibold uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-widest px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all duration-300
buttons_and_interactions.hover_row: Border-b border-[#1F1F1F] py-8 sm:py-12 transition-all duration-500 hover:pl-6 hover:bg-neutral-950 flex justify-between items-center group cursor-pointer

loading_screen.description: Preloader featuring geometric red 4-triangle logo mark assembling with counter 0% -> 100%, reveals the homepage via split curtain reveal.

navbar.description: Sticky dark backdrop-blur-md navbar (bg-black/85) with official Adelfos Logo, navigation links (Work, Services, Method, About, Insights), and 'BUILD YOUR EMPIRE' primary CTA. Fullscreen mobile drawer with big typographic links.

hero.description: Black hero with kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal: 'WE BUILD DIGITAL EMPIRES FOR LOCAL BUSINESS.' Includes interactive 3D particle landscape/mesh canvas, quick stats, and red accent pulse indicator.

attention_typographic_statement.description: Massive full-bleed statement text: 'MEDIOCRE MARKETING IS AN EXISTENTIAL RISK.' Interactive text highlight on hover & scroll.

sticky_adelfos_method.description: 5-Step Sticky Scroll Section: 01 AUDIT & DESTRUCTION, 02 EMPIRE ARCHITECTURE, 03 HYPER-TARGETED ACQUISITION, 04 BRAND DOMINANCE, 05 SCALED MONOPOLY. As users scroll, sticky left column displays current phase while right column transitions narrative & visuals.

services_index_hover_rows.description: Interactive large hover rows listing core services. Hovering a service reveals a dynamic floating image preview near the cursor.

real_estate_3d_section.description: Dedicated feature section spotlighting Calgary Real Estate 3D rendering, interactive floorplan viewer simulation, lighting toggles, and high-impact exterior imagery.

featured_case_studies.description: Asymmetric 2-column & 1-column showcase of Calgary business case studies with metric badges (e.g. +340% Revenue, #1 Google Rank, $14M Real Estate Sold).

metrics_section.description: Interactive ROI calculator & empire metric counter ($42M+ Client Revenue Generated, 180+ Local Businesses Scaled, 99.4% Retention).

testimonials_carousel.description: High-contrast testimonial slider featuring Calgary founders & real estate executives, quote typography, headshots, and verified Google rating badge.

insights_grid.description: Editorial 3-card grid of Calgary market marketing breakdowns and tactical playbooks.

final_cta.description: Oversized CTA banner: 'READY TO CLAIM YOUR MARKET SHARE?' with direct booking integration triggers & instant contact form.

footer.description: Deep dark footer featuring massive 'ADELFOS' outline watermark text, Calgary HQ address, office hours, dynamic clock (Calgary MST time), sitemap, and copyright statement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Syne, Plus Jakarta Sans, Instrument Serif, and JetBrains Mono in public/index.html or index.css.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll or custom scroll handling to ensure liquid smooth movement.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals, sticky section transitions, custom cursor, and logo geometric page transition overlay.
Strictly follow data-testid naming conventions on buttons, nav links, form elements, metrics, cards, and modals.
Maintain high-contrast dark theme (#000000 / #0A0A0A) with razor-sharp 1px subtle borders (#1F1F1F) and high impact red accent (#FF3131).
Build all 11 Service Detail Pages dynamically or with rich specialized content for each sub-discipline.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or modals without blur/scrim.
Ensure contrast meets APCA standard with readable off-white and pure white text over dark surfaces.
Do NOT introduce rounded bubble cards, heavy cyan gradients, or corporate stock icons.
